evidence.note: The data source kind record sets Authentication with an Aad block: AuthorizationUri, Scope, and DefaultClientApplication. No anonymous, key, or username-password kind is declared.
Reaches the Synapse and ARM REST APIs through Web.Contents.
Reaches serverless and dedicated SQL databases through Sql.Database.
Shared entry function takes one optional record parameter, options.
Declares the optional option as record parameter type.

options-fields.text: The options record is accepted but never read. The Synapse.Contents body ignores it, so no fields are accepted in practice.

evidence.note: options is declared but not referenced in the body.
Each request is a single Web.Contents call. No next-link, token, or offset loop exists.
Response bodies are parsed with Json.Document. The workspaces, databases, tables, and relationships returned by the connector are JSON payloads.
Sql.Database returns driver-provided tables, which become the data tables in CreateNavForTables (line 124).
Maps source TypeName boolean to M type logical for named columns. This is the connector's own source-type-to-M-type mapping.
Applies Table.TransformColumnTypes to returned data tables. Called from CombineTableMetadata (line 173).
Navigator column names come from JSON record fields (id, name) with no declared M types.
Table.FromRecords builds helper table columns from the JSON records.
Column names and types come from the Sql.Database driver.
The boolean mapping fires only on metadata entries. Whether an empty result keeps the declared columns depends on metadata that may be empty, so the answer is unclear.

Web.Contents sets ManualStatusHandling = {400, 404, 408, 500, 504}. Because of operator precedence, the options ?? [] & [...] expression may drop ManualStatusHandling when options is non-null, which GetARMContents (line 292) and the other callers with options pass. Those calls fall back to default status handling. The precedence reading is uncertain.
Builds Error.Record values for HTTP 400, 404, 408/504, and 5xx responses.
Sets Documentation.Name, Caption, and LongDescription on the Synapse.Contents function type. Examples is empty, so no sample values.
The navigator's workspace rows are listed at runtime from the ARM Resource Graph.
Workspace rows have IsLeaf false and open database navigation tables, so they are folders.
Database rows have IsLeaf false and open table navigation tables.
TestConnection = (resource) => {"Synapse.Contents"}, which names the shared entry function itself.
Folding is delegated to Sql.Database. No Table.View handlers or native query support are written.
The whole connector is a single .pq file.
Extension.LoadString is used for localized strings.
Icon PNGs are loaded with Extension.Contents.
Publish sets Beta = true.

Diagnostics.Trace runs on the live credential path (TraceLevel.Error at 415 and TraceLevel.Information at 424) with no EnableTraceOutput-style switch. GetResourceCredential is called from the live ARM, Synapse, and SQL paths.
Requests are synchronous with no job polling.
All calls are read-only GET or resource-graph queries. No Action functions exist.
